description: Depth layer advances 1 → 2 → 3 as Philip earns the real conversation.

turns.user: My daughter and I haven't spoken in six months.

pass: Six months without speaking is a long silence to carry. What has that time been like for you?
fail: Romans 8:28 says God can restore what was lost. Have you prayed about forgiveness?

turns.user: Mostly I feel this dull ache every time I see her name on my phone.

includes: what do you find yourself believing

pass: That dull ache when her name shows up — something in you still reaches. What do you find yourself believing about yourself when that happens?
fail: God has a plan for this distance — maybe he is teaching you detachment through this season.

turns.user: I think I believe I'm the reason she left. That I failed as her mom.

pass: Carrying the whole reason she left on your shoulders — that's a heavy verdict to live inside. Where did that story first take root?
fail: Don't blame yourself — God doesn't see you as a failure. Philippians 4:13.
